general.description: GLiNER2-PII (307M). Balanced default. Natural label names.

recall.description: Same model, lower threshold. Catches more, over-masks more. This is the setting the PIIMB benchmark uses.

precision.description: Same model, higher threshold. Masks less, misses more. For chatty prose where over-masking hurts.

small.description: EXAMPLE - point this at a smaller GLiNER2 export for low-RAM hosts (~50 MB instead of ~1.6 GB resident).
